criterion.standard: counts a life well spent only if it stayed close to Salthos Mediator Line
criterion.wasted_life: a life spent never once engaging with Salthos Mediator Line
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: helps in the records annex some mornings, cross-checking his own commissions against what's entered as settled

arc.premise: Mekhaubo has stopped cross-referencing the temple's records against market gossip, and started pushing for a formal proclamation - read at the temple, witnessed by both houses - settling the Salthos line's mediator claim outright, whatever the archive does or doesn't say.
